summary:
GLP-1 radar, 2026-10-14. The plague lane is over. Every candidate below is a GLP-1 topic, checked against today's signals plus web searches.

Top picks:
1. **Bootleg "Reta" (retatrutide).** CBS News reported on Oct 13 that the FDA received reports of 2 deaths. Poison-center exposures went from 249 to 460 to 862 per quarter. This fits our proven format: a myth-bust about online products that cites the regulator or manufacturer.
2. **Retatrutide's TRIUMPH-2 Phase 3 in type 2 diabetes.** Published in The Lancet: 20.8% weight loss at 12 mg vs 4.0% on placebo over 80 weeks. Lilly reports earnings on Oct 29, which should give it another push. Retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026.
3. **Foundayo (orforglipron) vs oral semaglutide, ACHIEVE-3.** Head-to-head in type 2 diabetes. Foundayo was approved for obesity on Apr 1, 2026. Fits the pill lane.
4. **Keeping weight off after stopping.** A pilot RCT (n=39) plus coverage in Medical News Today, Business Insider and local TV. We can add SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN and ATTAIN-MAINTAIN for context.
5. **GLP-1s and pregnancy or fertility.** Medscape covered an international consensus, ABC covered fertility, and there's a reassuring meta-analysis on exposure around conception.

Also worth doing:
- the EADV fingernail study (observational, so frame it calmly);
- Wegovy pill vs shot (seen in 3 snapshots, momentum easing);
- tirzepatide vs Wegovy HD (an indirect comparison only, never call it head-to-head);
- GLP-1s and alcohol or addiction (Nature feature, new trials);
- a myth-bust on GLP-1 "patches" (real ones are still in development);
- muscle protection, with a new primate-study hook.

Lower priority: the eloralintide combo's dropout catch, surgery and anesthesia reminders, tirzepatide and diabetic eye disease, the schizophrenia data, "Ozempic face", and the psoriasis story (momentum falling: 58, 55, 46).

Rejected: cheap compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide telehealth plans.

Following the playbook, rising topics with a named drug lead, and tirzepatide or Mounjaro goes in the title where that's accurate.

Not verified: the Bloomberg schizophrenia study, the Medscape pregnancy consensus document, and the 1,200-person Pittsburgh trial size. The eloralintide numbers came from a search summary. Check all of these before scripting.

candidates.topic: Bootleg 'Reta' (retatrutide): the FDA received reports of 2 deaths, and US poison-center exposures nearly doubled to 862 in Jul–Sep 2026
candidates.angle: Myth-bust: 'Online Reta isn't the trial drug.' Set what Lilly's Phase 3 trials tested (real retatrutide, under medical supervision) against what online vendors sell. Lilly says it found products 'with too much, too little, or the wrong active ingredient' plus contaminants. Keep the hedge: the reports alone don't prove the products caused the deaths (CBS). Retatrutide is investigational and not FDA-approved as of Oct 2026. Close by pointing to a prescriber for approved options. Never name a seller or say how to buy.
candidates.why_now: CBS published its investigation on Oct 13. NewsNation, Gizmodo, MedPage, Medical Daily, Becker's and PharmaVoice picked it up within 24 h, and SEO search-term pages are multiplying ('what is reta', 'fda concerns unapproved glp-1 drugs retatrutide'). Our online-retatrutide Short got 56 views, and the plague 'cures online' Short got 82, so the format works for us.

evidence.signal: FDA received 2 death reports (a 41-year-old in July, a 49-year-old in September) naming black-market retatrutide. Poison-center exposures were 249, 460 and 862 per quarter. Lilly statement quoted.
2 deaths reported to the FDA after people took products claiming to be retatrutide

evidence.source: Google News: Gizmodo, Medical Daily, PharmaVoice
evidence.signal: The story spread across outlets on Oct 13–14

candidates.topic: Retatrutide in type 2 diabetes, TRIUMPH-2 Phase 3 (The Lancet, EASD 2026): 20.8% average weight loss at 12 mg vs 4.0% on placebo over 80 weeks
candidates.angle: Named-drug trial decoder: 'Retatrutide in type 2 diabetes: what the Phase 3 trial showed.' Population: 1,152 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes. Lilly reported up to 40% reaching a normal A1C. Common GI side effects with placebo comparators: nausea up to 28.0% vs 8.0%, diarrhea up to 33.6% vs 13.2%. It's investigational as of Oct 2026. This trial didn't compare it with tirzepatide, so the title can't claim it 'beat' tirzepatide. Pairs with the bootleg-Reta Short: 'the real data vs the online product'.
candidates.why_now: Medical Xpress and the Indian Practitioner covered TRIUMPH-2 on Oct 13–14. Yahoo ran 'when could retatrutide be available' on Oct 14, and Motley Fool says retatrutide matters more than Lilly's quarter. The deaths story is pushing people to search for the real drug.

evidence.signal: TRIUMPH-2: 12.7%, 19.1% and 20.8% weight loss at 4, 9 and 12 mg vs 4.0% on placebo at 80 weeks
Phase 3 trial finds major weight loss in people with diabetes
'What is retatrutide and when could it be publicly available?'

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) vs oral semaglutide, ACHIEVE-3: the first head-to-head of two GLP-1 pills (type 2 diabetes, 52 weeks)
candidates.angle: 'Two GLP-1 pills, head to head: which lowered blood sugar more?' Lilly reported A1C drops of 2.2% (orforglipron 17.2 mg) vs 1.4% (oral semaglutide 14 mg, the diabetes dose, not the 25 mg Wegovy pill). Weight loss was 19.7 lb vs 11.0 lb. Add the plain mechanism angle: orforglipron is a non-peptide pill with no food or water timing rules, while the semaglutide pill uses SNAC. Status: orforglipron (Foundayo) was FDA-approved for chronic weight management on Apr 1, 2026. Keep the population as adults with type 2 diabetes. Include the prescriber line.
candidates.why_now: Stocktwits ran 'Foundayo beats Novo's oral semaglutide' on Oct 14, HealthDay covered orforglipron's cardiovascular safety at EASD the same day, and Medical News Today covered orforglipron by menopausal stage on Oct 13. The pill lane is our best Instagram signal (52 reach in 1 day).

evidence.signal: ACHIEVE-3: Foundayo outperformed oral semaglutide on the primary and all key secondary endpoints
FDA approves orforglipron for adults with obesity
EASD: orforglipron shows cardiovascular safety comparable to insulin glargine

candidates.topic: Weight regain after stopping a GLP-1: new pilot RCT (n=39) found ~3.6% regain with a wellness app or medically tailored meals vs ~10.75% with usual care over 4 months
candidates.angle: 'Stopped your GLP-1? What a new trial tested to slow regain.' Report the estimated figures with the exact population: adults who had lost more than 10% on a GLP-1 and stopped less than 30 days earlier. Include the caveat: it's a small pilot, and both groups still gained weight. Add trial context (STEP 1 extension, SURMOUNT-4) plus SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN and ATTAIN-MAINTAIN as 'what Lilly's maintenance trials tested'. No stopping or switching advice. Make the habits actionable (protein, strength training, structured meals) and end with 'plan any change with your prescriber'.
keywords: how to keep weight off after wegovy
what happens when you stop zepbound
candidates.why_now: Medical News Today, Business Insider ('not a free lunch'), ABC27 and the Statesman Journal all covered maintenance on Oct 14, and News-Medical covered the trial on Oct 7 and 11. It's evergreen demand with a fresh RCT hook, and it's on our double-down list.

evidence.signal: Preventing Weight Regain After GLP-1 Therapy Discontinuation: A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
Stopping GLP-1 drugs often brings weight back. A small trial suggests ways to slow it
A dietitian says GLP-1s aren't 'a free lunch': you need a plan when you stop

candidates.topic: GLP-1 medicines, pregnancy and fertility: international consensus (Medscape), plus a new meta-analysis finding no 'clearly detectable increase' in adverse outcomes after exposure around conception
candidates.angle: 'Planning a pregnancy on semaglutide or tirzepatide? What the evidence and guidance say.' The reassuring part: a Sept 2026 meta-analysis of 10 studies on exposure around conception. The guidance part: labels and guidelines advise stopping before a planned pregnancy, about 2 months for semaglutide. Frame that as what the label says to discuss with your prescriber, not as personal instructions. Mention that GLP-1s can reduce how well oral contraceptives work only where the label states it (tirzepatide). Avoid 'Ozempic babies' hype.
keywords: can I get pregnant on zepbound
candidates.why_now: Medscape covered the international consensus on Oct 14, ABC News ran a fertility feature on Oct 14, a City St George's meta-analysis came out in October, and JCEM published preconception incretins in PCOS on Oct 10. Women 25–45 are a big part of our audience.

evidence.signal: International Consensus Addresses GLP-1 RA Use in Pregnancy

evidence.source: City St George's, University of London (Oct 2026)
evidence.signal: Largest study to date finds no detectable increase in pregnancy risks after GLP-1 exposure around conception
Preconception incretin therapy reduces pregnancy and cardiometabolic outcomes in PCOS

candidates.topic: GLP-1s and fingernail problems: an EADV 2026 study found nail detachment in 39% of 575 GLP-1 users vs 9% of 1,329 non-users with obesity or type 2 diabetes
candidates.angle: 'Do GLP-1s affect your nails? What a new study found (and didn't).' Answer within 10 s: it's linked, not proven to be caused by the drug. About half of users said they had nail problems before starting, and the data are self-reported. Then give practical, helpful points: adequate protein, and see a clinician or dermatologist about nail changes. Calm, not scary. Bodily-effects questions lead for us, but safety framing underperforms, so lead with the question, not alarm. No emoji in the hook.
candidates.why_now: ScienceDaily, Men's Journal, Gizmodo, ScienceAlert and MDLinx all covered it Oct 11–13 after the EADV presentation. It's a viral 'what is this doing to my body' question with little careful coverage.

evidence.signal: Popular weight loss drugs linked to a surprising fingernail problem
GLP-1 users report fingernail detachment
Experts have found an unexpected side effect of weight-loss drugs

candidates.topic: Wegovy pill vs Wegovy shot: oral semaglutide passed 100,000 obesity prescriptions a month within 2 months (JAMA Netw Open), and it's now approved in the EU
candidates.angle: 'Wegovy pill vs the shot: what's actually different?' Cover the daily tablet vs the weekly injection, the morning routine needed for absorption (described generally, no dosing), the trial weight loss of about 17% vs 3% on placebo, and the same common GI side effects. Status: US approval Dec 22, 2025, EU approval 2026. Follows on from our semaglutide-pill Short (52 Instagram reach).
keywords: how effective is the wegovy pill
candidates.why_now: It's in its 3rd snapshot (70, 73, 62). Medscape covered the 100k prescriptions on Oct 12, Yahoo ran 'which GLP-1 you're most likely to be prescribed' on Oct 14, and 'how effective is the wegovy pill' search pages are appearing. Momentum is easing slightly, so use the comparison angle.

evidence.signal: Early Adoption and Diffusion of Oral Semaglutide in US Adults With Obesity
Oral semaglutide obesity prescriptions top 100K a month within 2 months
Novo Nordisk wins EU approval for the Wegovy pill

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Zepbound) vs high-dose semaglutide (Wegovy HD 7.2 mg): Lilly's indirect comparison reports 4.5 percentage points more weight loss at 72 weeks for tirzepatide 15 mg
candidates.angle: 'Zepbound vs Wegovy HD: which led to more weight loss?' Name both sides. The key teaching point: this is an indirect statistical comparison (ML-NMR of SURMOUNT-1 and STEP UP, reported by Lilly, the maker of tirzepatide), not a head-to-head trial. Cover what Wegovy HD is (FDA-approved Mar 2026, for adults with obesity) without giving titration steps. Tirzepatide in the title fits our best-performing pattern.
keywords: which is stronger zepbound or wegovy
candidates.why_now: Verywell published a Wegovy vs Wegovy HD explainer on Oct 12, Lilly released the comparison on Sep 29, and 'tirzepatide vs semaglutide 2026' search pages are spreading. Tirzepatide titles have a median of 90 views for us.

evidence.source: ChemXplore summary of the Lilly release (Sep 29, 2026)
evidence.signal: ML-NMR indirect comparison: tirzepatide 15 mg −4.5 pp (95% CrI −6.3 to −2.8) vs semaglutide 7.2 mg
FDA approves higher-dose semaglutide (Wegovy HD)
Wegovy vs Wegovy HD: who should consider the higher dose?

candidates.topic: Can semaglutide reduce drinking? GLP-1s for alcohol and opioid use disorder: a Nature feature, a large new Pittsburgh trial, and early RCT data
candidates.angle: 'Does Ozempic curb alcohol cravings? What trials show so far.' Cover the small early RCT (heavy-drinking days fell in a 2025 trial), the large trials now starting (VA, Pittsburgh), and status: not approved for addiction as of Oct 2026. Link it to the reward-system mechanism (Acta Neuropsychiatr review, animal data labelled as animal). Fun hook: the Atlanta Fed's Beige Book notes GLP-1s affecting alcohol demand.
candidates.why_now: Nature ran 'Can GLP-1s heal the brain?' on Oct 14. News-Medical and Vinetur covered the Pittsburgh trial on Oct 13–14, Medical Economics said 'semaglutide cuts heavy drinking' on Oct 13, and the Atlanta Fed Beige Book on Oct 14 mentions alcohol demand.

evidence.signal: Can GLP-1s heal the brain? Obesity drugs get a makeover for addiction and depression
Major trial seeks to test semaglutide in adults with alcohol and opioid use disorder
Systematic review: GLP-1 mono-agonists and reward processing in animal models

candidates.topic: GLP-1 'patches': real semaglutide and tirzepatide microneedle patches are still in development (Daewoong targets GMP approval for production in H1 2027), so patches sold online now aren't approved GLP-1s
candidates.angle: Myth-bust: 'Is there a GLP-1 patch yet?' The answer within 10 s: not an approved one, as of Oct 2026. Explain why getting a peptide through skin is hard, and note that the real candidates (Daewoong's microneedle patch, a tirzepatide patch entering US testing) are still in development. Warn that 'GLP-1 patches' sold online aren't the medicine. Never name sellers. Point to a prescriber.
candidates.why_now: Korea Biomedical Review and BriefAsia covered Daewoong on Oct 14, there was a tirzepatide patch announcement on Oct 13, and 'semaglutide patches for weight loss' search pages are appearing. It's the same myth-bust format as our online-retatrutide Short (56 views).

evidence.signal: Daewoong targets H1 2027 GMP approval for semaglutide microneedle patch production
'semaglutide patches for weight loss' search-term page

candidates.topic: Protecting muscle on tirzepatide (Mounjaro) or semaglutide: the SURMOUNT-1 body-scan substudy, plus new primate data (activin E antibody IBIO-610 shifted semaglutide weight loss toward fat)
candidates.angle: Evergreen winner with a fresh hook: 'Is the weight you lose on tirzepatide fat or muscle?' Use the SURMOUNT-1 DXA substudy (population: obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition, without diabetes). Then 'scientists are testing add-on drugs to keep more muscle'. The IBIO-610 result is a monkey study, not a human result. Finish with recommended habits: protein (check first if you have kidney disease) and strength training (start gently).
keywords: how to keep muscle on ozempic
candidates.why_now: BioPharm International covered the primate data on Oct 13 and the frailty and falls paper came out on Oct 7. Muscle is our cross-platform GLP-1 winner (98 views, 61 reach), and turning the carousel into a Short is already planned.

evidence.signal: Activin E antibody IBIO-610 shifts semaglutide weight loss toward fat in obese primates
Association of GLP-1 receptor agonist use with frailty and falls in adults with type 2 diabetes

candidates.topic: Eloralintide plus tirzepatide in type 2 diabetes: 23.3% vs 14.8% weight loss with tirzepatide alone, but more people stopped because of side effects
candidates.angle: A follow-up to our EloraTZP long-form (322 views): 'More weight loss, but what's the catch?' Report the dropout rates honestly next to the efficacy, attributed as 'Lilly reported'. Explain amylin simply. The combination is investigational as of Oct 2026. Check the exact numbers against Lilly's release before scripting, because they came from a search summary.
candidates.why_now: Motley Fool and Yahoo ran 'significantly more weight loss... discontinuation far higher' on Oct 12, and Drug Discovery News said the amylin combo 'raises the bar' on Oct 14. Our audience already engages with this drug.

evidence.signal: Eli Lilly Zepbound plus amylin combination study
Combination results release
Lilly's amylin combo raises the bar, and the stakes, for obesity drug developers

candidates.topic: On a GLP-1 and facing surgery (spine fusion, hip replacement, cardiac surgery)? New systematic reviews on safety around the operation
candidates.angle: Practical 'you' action in the anesthesia format (82 views): 'On semaglutide or tirzepatide? Tell your surgical and anesthesia team before an operation.' Explain why (slower stomach emptying) using the new spine-surgery systematic review. Add 'don't stop or change your current medicines on your own; your care team will advise'. No hold or stop instructions.
candidates.why_now: Three new reviews or cohorts came out Sep–Oct (spine fusion, hip arthroplasty revision, cardiac surgery glycemic control). This format is proven on our YouTube.

evidence.source: PubMed: N Am Spine Soc J (Sep 2026)
evidence.signal: GLP-1 RAs in elective spine surgery: systematic review of fusion outcomes and perioperative safety
GLP-1 RAs linked to lower early revision risk vs bariatric surgery after total hip arthroplasty (retrospective)

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide and diabetic eye disease: a large cohort (n=173,846) linked tirzepatide to lower rates of diabetic retinopathy vs lifestyle intervention alone
candidates.angle: Benefits beyond weight, with tirzepatide in the title: 'Does tirzepatide (Mounjaro) affect diabetic eye disease?' It's observational, so say 'linked to', with the population: adults with diabetes and overweight or obesity. Mention the semaglutide NAION signal only briefly and calmly for balance, and recommend regular eye exams.
candidates.why_now: Medical Economics ran 'tirzepatide tied to lower diabetic eye disease risk' on Oct 13. It contrasts with the 'Wegovy eye stroke' headlines (Medical Economics, Oct 14), and few creators have done the balanced version.

evidence.signal: Weight loss drug linked to lower risk of eye disease in patients with diabetes (Ophthalmology)
Tirzepatide tied to lower diabetic eye disease risk

candidates.topic: GLP-1 drugs and fewer schizophrenia-related hospital visits (Bloomberg, Oct 14), plus earlier data on psychiatric hospital care
candidates.angle: 'Could GLP-1s help mental health? What the early data show.' It's observational, so say 'linked to'. Population: people with schizophrenia, who often gain weight on antipsychotics. Add 'don't stop or change your current medicines on your own'. Wait for the underlying paper before scripting; we haven't found it yet.
candidates.why_now: Bloomberg published at 22:30 GMT on Oct 14, very early. It ties in with the Nature brain feature and STAT's study on GLP-1s and the criminal justice system, employment and housing.

evidence.signal: GLP-1 drugs cut schizophrenia hospital visits, study finds
New study examines GLP-1 impact on interactions with the criminal justice system, employment and housing stability

candidates.topic: Is 'Ozempic face' real? A new systematic review of facial changes linked to GLP-1 medicines (Aesthetic Plast Surg, Oct 12)
candidates.angle: A gentle myth-correction: 'Ozempic face' describes facial fat changes that come with weight loss in general, not a unique drug toxicity. Report what the review actually found. No before/after images, no shaming, and no promotion of aesthetic treatments. Remember weight is one health measure among many.
candidates.why_now: A new systematic review came out on Oct 12, and WWD covered a 'GLP-1 facial' launch on Oct 14. The search term stays popular.

evidence.signal: Beyond Weight Loss: Facial Remodeling Associated with GLP-1 Receptor Agonists, a systematic review

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide plus ixekizumab for psoriasis with obesity (TOGETHER-PsO): 40.6% reached completely clear skin vs 29.0% with ixekizumab alone
candidates.angle: Only as a single 'benefits beyond weight' Short if a slot needs filling: 'Can tirzepatide help psoriasis treatment work better?' Keep the exact population and comparator, and attribute it as 'Lilly reported'.
candidates.why_now: Seen in 3 snapshots with momentum falling (58, 55, 46). The Hill and pharmaphorum covered it on Oct 12, with no new pickup since.

evidence.signal: Lilly's Zepbound enhances Taltz efficacy in psoriasis study

candidates.topic: Cheap compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide telehealth plans ($86–$99 a month) and price indexes for compounded GLP-1s
candidates.angle: REJECT: covering this would promote compounded or gray-market sources, which the brand rules ban. If the subject comes up at all, it only goes in a general 'get GLP-1s through a licensed prescriber' message, with no prices and no providers named.
candidates.why_now: Several sponsored or press-release stories ran Oct 12–14 (Ozari, NexLife, Arbor).

evidence.signal: NexLife October 2026 GLP-1 Price Index on compounded tirzepatide and semaglutide
